The cook smelled the fish ___ (curious).
That noise in the next room sounds ___ (a fiddle).
The local busker's voice sounds ___ (soft).
The busker played his fiddle ___ (wonderful).

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch?
aufgabe.satz: When the doctor told her the news, Grandma went very quiet and looked out of the window.
loesungen: When the doctor told her the news, Grandma went very quiet and looked out of the window.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Richtig: go quiet (still werden) mit Adjektiv; looked out of the window ist eine Handlung ohne Adjektiv.

aufgabe.anweisung: Welcher Satz sagt etwas darüber, wie das Essen riecht? Wähle den richtigen Satz.
loesungen: The Irish stew in the pot smelled delicious.
optionen: The dog smelled the Irish stew in the pot curiously.
The Irish stew in the pot smelled delicious.
The Irish stew in the pot smelled deliciously.
aufgabe.erklaerung: smell + Adjektiv beschreibt den Geruch; smell + Adverb beschreibt, wie jemand an etwas riecht.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Wort in der richtigen Form ein.
aufgabe.satz: The climate in Ireland is mild, but the weather on the coast can change very ___.
aufgabe.erklaerung: change ist kein Verb wie look oder seem – es beschreibt einen Vorgang, also das Adverb quickly.

aufgabe.anweisung: Schreibe den Satz neu. Benutze seem in der richtigen Zeitform.
aufgabe.satz: I thought that the guide on the trail was very friendly.
loesungen: The guide on the trail seemed very friendly.
The guide on the trail seemed to be very friendly.
aufgabe.erklaerung: seem + Adjektiv (oder seem to be + Adjektiv), hier im simple past: seemed very friendly.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde einen Satz aus den Teilen.
loesungen: The air near the coast smells really fresh in the morning.
The air near the coast really smells fresh in the morning.
aufgabe.erklaerung: smell + Adjektiv: smells really fresh.

aufgabe.anweisung: Stelle die Frage zu der Antwort.
aufgabe.satz: She seemed really nervous.
loesungen: How did the new girl seem?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Frage nach dem Eindruck: How did … seem? – die Antwort nennt ein Adjektiv.
aufgabe.kontext: Your friend talked to the new girl in your class yesterday.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle für jede Lücke die richtige Form.
aufgabe.satz: Last week our class visited an old famine village in the west of Ireland. When we arrived, the sky turned ___ and it started to rain. The small stone houses looked empty and cold. Our guide spoke ___ about the families who lived there and died of starvation. Everybody went ___ when she showed us the photos. Inside one house it felt ___ a very sad place, and nobody wanted to stay long.
aufgabe.erklaerung: turned grey, went silent: Adjektive nach Verben des Werdens; spoke quietly: Adverb zur Handlung; felt like + Nomen.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Wort in der richtigen Form ein.
aufgabe.satz: Jack opened the box and felt inside it ___ with his fingers.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Hier heißt feel „tasten“ – eine Handlung, also das Adverb nervously (anders als: he felt nervous).
aufgabe.kontext: Jack found an old box in the cave near the beach. It was dark, and he couldn't see what was in it.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die richtige Form.
aufgabe.satz: Kate's new neighbour seems ___.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Nach seem steht das Adjektiv; like nur vor einem Nomen.
aufgabe.kontext: He helped Kate carry her heavy bags and invited her for a cup of tea.

aufgabe.anweisung: Kreuze alle richtigen Sätze an.
loesungen: The island seems very quiet in winter.
The island seems to be very quiet in winter.
The island appears very quiet in winter.
aufgabe.erklaerung: seem, seem to be und appear + Adjektiv sind gleichwertig; kein Adverb und kein like vor dem Adjektiv.
optionen: The island seems very quiet in winter.
The island seems to be very quiet in winter.
The island seems very quietly in winter.
The island appears very quiet in winter.
The island seems like very quiet in winter.

aufgabe.anweisung: Finde das falsche Wort und berichtige es.
aufgabe.satz: The busker's new song sounded so beautifully that some people in the crowd started to cry.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Das Lied klingt schön – nach sound steht das Adjektiv: sounded so beautiful.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die richtige Form.
aufgabe.satz: When we arrived at the cinema, the film ___.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Past perfect = had + 3. Form: had already started.

aufgabe.anweisung: Markiere in den past-perfect-Formen die 3. Form des Verbs (drei Wörter).
aufgabe.satz: When Ravi arrived in London, he had never seen such a big city before. His cousin had found a room for him, and Ravi had saved some money for the first weeks.
aufgabe.erklaerung: had seen, had found, had saved: had + 3. Form; arrived ist simple past.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch? Wenn er falsch ist, berichtige das falsche Wort.
aufgabe.satz: By the time the ship arrived in Britain, the passengers had spend three weeks at sea.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Falsch: Nach had steht die 3. Form – had spent.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ordne jedem Verb die richtige Form im past perfect zu.
loesungen: go had gone | eat had eaten | buy had bought | write had written
aufgabe.erklaerung: Past perfect = had + 3. Form; unregelmäßige Verben haben eigene 3. Formen.

eat
buy
write

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: Sophie couldn't pay for her lunch because she ___ her money at home.
aufgabe.erklaerung: had + 3. Form von leave: had left.

aufgabe.anweisung: Schreibe den Satz im past perfect.
aufgabe.satz: Ella has finished her homework.
loesungen: When her friend called, Ella had finished her homework.
When her friend called, Ella'd finished her homework.
When her friend called, Ella had already finished her homework.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Aus has finished wird had finished.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde einen Satz aus den Teilen.
loesungen: When we got to the party, everyone had eaten the cake.
aufgabe.erklaerung: had + 3. Form: everyone had eaten.

aufgabe.anweisung: Stelle die Frage zu der Antwort im past perfect.
aufgabe.satz: No, I hadn't. It was my first time there.
loesungen: Had you been to London before?
Had you ever been to London before?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Frage im past perfect: Had + Subjekt + 3. Form.
aufgabe.kontext: Your friend visited London last summer. You ask about the time before the trip.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze die Verben im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: My grandfather came to Britain in 1962. Before he left his home, he ___ his bike to pay for the ticket. The journey was long, and when the ship arrived, he ___ at sea for three weeks. He was tired and hungry because he ___ much on the ship. But it was a good start: his cousin ___ a job for him in a textile factory.
loesungen: had already sold | had been | hadn't eaten | had already found
aufgabe.erklaerung: Alles geschah vor der Ankunft: had sold, had been, hadn't eaten, had found.

aufgabe.anweisung: Verbinde die beiden Sätze mit after. Benutze das past perfect.
aufgabe.satz: First Amir saved money for two years. Then he bought a ticket to Britain.
loesungen: After Amir had saved money for two years, he bought a ticket to Britain.
After Amir had saved money for two years he bought a ticket to Britain.
Amir bought a ticket to Britain after he had saved money for two years.
After he had saved money for two years, Amir bought a ticket to Britain.
After he had saved money for two years Amir bought a ticket to Britain.
After Amir'd saved money for two years, he bought a ticket to Britain.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Das Sparen kam zuerst: after + past perfect (had saved), danach simple past (bought).

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: When she got to the shop, they ___ the last one.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Das Verkaufen war vor Mias Ankunft schon passiert: had already sold.
aufgabe.kontext: Last Saturday Mia wanted to buy the new book about the British Empire.

aufgabe.anweisung: Sortiere: Ist die Form im past perfect richtig oder falsch gebildet?
loesungen: richtig: had taken, had written, had brought, had stayed | falsch: had went, had stay, had took, had wrote
aufgabe.erklaerung: Nach had steht immer die 3. Form (taken, written, brought, stayed) – nicht die Grundform und nicht die 2. Form.

aufgabe.anweisung: Finde das falsche Wort und berichtige es.
aufgabe.satz: The museum was closed because the guide had forget the key.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Nach had steht die 3. Form: had forgotten.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die richtige Form.
aufgabe.satz: By 1900 Britain ___ a huge empire with colonies all over the world.
aufgabe.erklaerung: by 1900 = bis zu einem Zeitpunkt in der Vergangenheit → had + 3. Form: had built.

aufgabe.anweisung: Markiere in den drei past-perfect-Formen jeweils die 3. Form des Verbs.
aufgabe.satz: Before the first trains, people had transported goods by carriage. By 1850 Britain had developed lots of new machines, and many factories had become much bigger.
aufgabe.erklaerung: had transported, had developed, had become: had + 3. Form.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch? Wenn er falsch ist, berichtige das falsche Wort.
aufgabe.satz: Leo couldn't talk because he had ran all the way to school.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Falsch: ran ist die 2. Form; die 3. Form von run ist run – had run.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ordne die Satzhälften richtig zu.
loesungen: Emma couldn't open the front door because she had lost her key. | Ben wasn't hungry at dinner because he had eaten a big lunch. | In the morning the streets were white because it had snowed all night. | At the airport Grandpa cried because he hadn't seen his son for ten years.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Der Grund liegt vor dem Ereignis in der Vergangenheit – deshalb had + 3. Form.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb im past perfect ein.

aufgabe.erklaerung: had + 3. Form eines regelmäßigen Verbs: had established.

aufgabe.anweisung: Mache aus dem Satz eine Frage.
aufgabe.satz: The people in the village had used machines before.
loesungen: Had the people in the village used machines before?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Frage im past perfect: Had + Subjekt + 3. Form.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde einen Satz aus den Teilen.
loesungen: My grandfather had never travelled overseas before.
aufgabe.erklaerung: never steht zwischen had und der 3. Form: had never travelled.

aufgabe.anweisung: Stelle die Frage zu der Antwort im past perfect.
aufgabe.satz: They had lived in a small village in the north.
loesungen: Where had Ali's family lived before?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Fragewort + had + Subjekt + 3. Form: Where had they lived?
aufgabe.kontext: Ali's family came to Britain in 1975. You want to know about the time before that.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze die Verben im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: In 1958 my grandmother arrived in London. She had a job as a nurse, but she ___ in a big hospital before. By the end of her first week, she ___ two good friends. Life wasn't easy, because the attitude of some people to immigrants was very bad. Some days she felt that she ___ the wrong country. But by 1965 she ___ my grandfather, and she was happy in her new home.
loesungen: had never worked | had made | had chosen | had met
aufgabe.erklaerung: had + 3. Form: had worked, had made, had chosen, had met – jeweils vor einem Zeitpunkt in der Vergangenheit.

aufgabe.anweisung: Verbinde die beiden Sätze mit before. Benutze das past perfect.
aufgabe.satz: First the servants cleaned the whole house. Then the guests arrived.
loesungen: The servants had cleaned the whole house before the guests arrived.
Before the guests arrived, the servants had cleaned the whole house.
Before the guests arrived the servants had cleaned the whole house.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Was zuerst passierte, steht im past perfect (had cleaned); before leitet das spätere Ereignis ein.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: The house was quiet because the children ___ to bed.
aufgabe.erklaerung: already steht zwischen had und der 3. Form: had already gone.
aufgabe.kontext: Kate's parents came home very late on Friday night.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ordne die Satzhälften richtig zu. Achte auf den Zeitpunkt.
loesungen: Look at all the glass on the floor! Someone has broken the window. | When we came home last night, someone had broken the window. | I can't find my phone anywhere. I think I have lost it. | Last Monday I couldn't call you because I had lost my phone.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Bezug zur Gegenwart → has/have + 3. Form; vor einem Zeitpunkt in der Vergangenheit → had + 3. Form.

aufgabe.anweisung: Finde das falsche Wort und berichtige es.
aufgabe.satz: Before he came to Britain, my grandfather had never drove a car.
aufgabe.erklaerung: drove ist die 2. Form; nach had steht die 3. Form driven.

aufgabe.anweisung: Markiere in den drei past-perfect-Formen jeweils die 3. Form des Verbs.
aufgabe.satz: When the first big ship from the Caribbean arrived in 1948, many passengers had already sold their homes. They had heard that Britain needed people, but nobody had told them how cold the winters were.
aufgabe.erklaerung: had sold, had heard, had told: had + 3. Form; arrived, needed und were sind simple past.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ordne jedem Verb die richtige Form im past perfect zu.
loesungen: beat had beaten | lead had led | choose had chosen | survive had survived | bring had brought
aufgabe.erklaerung: had + 3. Form; unregelmäßig: beaten, led, chosen, brought – regelmäßig: survived.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch? Wenn er falsch ist, berichtige das falsche Wort.
aufgabe.satz: Before the colony became independent, the British had took most of its natural resources.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Falsch: took ist die 2. Form; nach had steht die 3. Form taken.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die richtige Form.
aufgabe.satz: By the time the old textile factory closed in 1980, three generations of my family ___ there.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Aktiv, vor einem Zeitpunkt in der Vergangenheit (by the time … closed) → had worked.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: The textile industry in Britain grew fast because the colonies ___ cheap raw materials for many years.
aufgabe.erklaerung: had + 3. Form von send: had sent.

aufgabe.anweisung: Schreibe den Satz weiter. Benutze das past perfect.

loesungen: When Ravi went on the school trip last year, he hadn't learned to swim yet.
When Ravi went on the school trip last year, he had not learned to swim yet.
When Ravi went on the school trip last year, he hadn't learnt to swim yet.
When Ravi went on the school trip last year, he had not learnt to swim yet.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Aus hasn't learned wird hadn't learned, weil der Bezugspunkt jetzt in der Vergangenheit liegt.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde einen Satz aus den Teilen.
loesungen: By 1950, many people from the colonies had moved to Britain.
aufgabe.erklaerung: had + 3. Form: had moved.

aufgabe.anweisung: Stelle die Frage zu der Antwort im past perfect.
aufgabe.satz: They had sold their house and most of their belongings.
loesungen: What had they done before they left?
What had the Patel family done before they left?
What had the Patels done before they left?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Fragewort + had + Subjekt + 3. Form: What had they done …?
aufgabe.kontext: The Patel family left their country in 1972. You want to know what they did before that.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze die Verben im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: Between 1750 and 1850, life in Britain changed fast. By 1800, people ___ the first big factories, and many families ___ their farms to find work in the towns. Life there was hard. Children often worked twelve hours a day, and many of them ___ to school. When the first trains ran in the 1830s, engineers ___ machines that could do the work of a hundred people.
loesungen: had built | had left | had never gone | had already developed
aufgabe.erklaerung: Vor dem jeweiligen Zeitpunkt (by 1800, when the first trains ran) → had built, had left, had never gone, had already developed.

aufgabe.anweisung: Verbinde die beiden Sätze mit after. Benutze das past perfect.
aufgabe.satz: First Grandpa worked as a servant for five years. Then he opened his own shop.
loesungen: After Grandpa had worked as a servant for five years, he opened his own shop.
After Grandpa had worked as a servant for five years he opened his own shop.
Grandpa opened his own shop after he had worked as a servant for five years.
After he had worked as a servant for five years, Grandpa opened his own shop.
After he had worked as a servant for five years Grandpa opened his own shop.
Grandpa opened his own shop after he'd worked as a servant for five years.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Das frühere Ereignis steht nach after im past perfect (had worked), das spätere im simple past (opened).

aufgabe.anweisung: Stelle die Frage zu der Antwort im past perfect.
aufgabe.satz: No, they hadn't. They had only seen pictures of it.
loesungen: Had they ever seen Britain before?
Had the people ever seen Britain before?
Had the people ever seen Britain?
Had they ever seen Britain before the journey?
Had the people ever seen Britain before the journey?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Had + Subjekt + ever + 3. Form: Had they ever seen …?
aufgabe.kontext: In 1948 a ship brought hundreds of people from the colonies to Britain. You ask about the time before the journey.

aufgabe.anweisung: Steht ’d hier für had oder für would? Sortiere die Sätze.
loesungen: ’d = had: She'd never seen the sea before the trip., We'd already eaten when they arrived., They'd lost their way in the dark forest., By the time I called, he'd gone to bed. | ’d = would: I'd like a cup of tea, please., He'd help you if he had more time., If I were you, I'd take a warm jacket., My grandparents said they'd love to visit us.
aufgabe.erklaerung: ’d + 3. Form (seen, eaten, lost, gone) = had; ’d + Grundform (like, help, take, love) = would.

aufgabe.anweisung: Finde das falsche Wort und berichtige es.
aufgabe.satz: When the immigrants finally arrived in Britain, most of them had spended all their money on the journey.
aufgabe.erklaerung: spend ist unregelmäßig: had spent.

aufgabe.anweisung: Welcher Satz sagt, dass der Film schon lief, als Lily ankam? Wähle.
loesungen: When Lily arrived, the film had started.
optionen: When Lily arrived, the film started.
When Lily arrived, the film had started.
When Lily had arrived, the film started.
aufgabe.erklaerung: had started = der Film hatte schon vor Lilys Ankunft begonnen; started allein = er begann genau dann.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die richtige Form.
aufgabe.satz: By the time we got to the shop, it ___.
aufgabe.erklaerung: by the time + simple past → das frühere Ereignis steht im past perfect: had closed.

aufgabe.anweisung: Was war zuerst passiert? Markiere die zwei Wörter dieser Verbform.
aufgabe.satz: When Ben got to school, he saw that he had left his sports bag at home.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Ben hatte die Tasche vorher zu Hause gelassen → past perfect had left; got und saw folgen später.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch?
aufgabe.satz: Max had never been on a plane before his trip to London.
loesungen: Max had never been on a plane before his trip to London.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Richtig: never … before + Zeitpunkt in der Vergangenheit → had never been.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: When Mum came home from work, we ___ the kitchen.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Das Putzen war vor Mums Ankunft fertig: had already cleaned.

aufgabe.anweisung: Schreibe einen Satz mit before. Benutze das past perfect.
aufgabe.satz: First I finished my homework. Then I watched TV.
loesungen: Before I watched TV, I had finished my homework.
Before I watched TV, I'd finished my homework.
Before I watched TV, I had already finished my homework.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Was zuerst geschah (homework), steht im past perfect: had finished.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde einen Satz aus den Teilen.
loesungen: By the time we found our seats, the concert had already started.
aufgabe.erklaerung: by the time + simple past (found), das frühere Ereignis im past perfect (had already started).

aufgabe.anweisung: Stelle die Frage zu der Antwort im past perfect.
aufgabe.satz: No, she hadn't. It was her first concert.
loesungen: Had she ever been to a concert before?
Had Emma ever been to a concert before?
Had she ever been to a concert?
Had Emma ever been to a concert?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Frage nach der Zeit vor dem Konzert: Had + Subjekt + ever + 3. Form.
aufgabe.kontext: Last Saturday Emma went to a big concert with her friends.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze die Verben im past perfect oder im simple past ein.
aufgabe.satz: Last Saturday my family ___ to an Indian restaurant for Grandpa's birthday. I was a bit nervous because I ___ Indian food before. By the time we arrived, Grandpa ___ chicken tikka masala for everyone. I ___ it and I loved it! When we finally left, we ___ there for three hours.
loesungen: went | had never eaten | had already ordered | tried | had been
aufgabe.erklaerung: Handlungsfolge im simple past (went, tried); was vorher schon passiert war, im past perfect (never … before, by the time, bis zum Gehen).

aufgabe.anweisung: Verbinde die beiden Sätze mit after. Benutze das past perfect.
aufgabe.satz: First the family packed all their belongings. Then they left for Britain.
loesungen: After the family had packed all their belongings, they left for Britain.
After the family had packed all their belongings they left for Britain.
The family left for Britain after they had packed all their belongings.
After they had packed all their belongings, the family left for Britain.
After they had packed all their belongings the family left for Britain.
The family left for Britain after they'd packed all their belongings.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Das Packen kam zuerst: after + past perfect (had packed), danach simple past (left).

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: When she opened the door, her friends ___ behind the sofa.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Die Freunde hatten sich schon vorher versteckt: had already hidden.
aufgabe.kontext: Amy's friends wanted to give her a surprise party. Amy came home at six.

aufgabe.anweisung: Welcher Satz sagt, dass das Essen schon fertig war, als Jack nach Hause kam? Wähle.
loesungen: When Jack came home, Mum had cooked dinner.
optionen: When Jack came home, Mum cooked dinner.
When Jack came home, Mum had cooked dinner.
When Jack had come home, Mum cooked dinner.
aufgabe.erklaerung: had cooked = vor Jacks Ankunft fertig; cooked = Mum kochte erst, als er kam.

optionen: When Raj got to the harbour, the ship had left.
When Raj got to the harbour, the ship left.
When Raj got to the harbour, the ship was leaving.
Raj got to the harbour before the ship left.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Nur had left sagt, dass das Schiff schon vor Rajs Ankunft abgefahren war.

aufgabe.anweisung: Finde das falsche Wort und berichtige es.
aufgabe.satz: Long before the first railway was built, people in Britain have transported goods on rivers.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Vor einem Zeitpunkt in der Vergangenheit (was built) → past perfect: had transported.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die richtige Form.
aufgabe.satz: Ben was hungry at lunch because he ___ breakfast.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Verneinung im past perfect: hadn't + 3. Form (eat – ate – eaten).

aufgabe.anweisung: Ordne jeder Frage die passende Kurzantwort zu.
loesungen: Had you been to the museum before? No, I hadn't. | Did you like the museum? Yes, I did. | Had Grandpa travelled by plane before? No, he hadn't. | Was Grandpa nervous on the plane? Yes, he was.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Die Kurzantwort nimmt das Hilfsverb der Frage auf: Had …? → I had / I hadn't.

paare.links: Had you been to the museum before?
Did you like the museum?
Had Grandpa travelled by plane before?
Was Grandpa nervous on the plane?

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch?
aufgabe.satz: Had you visited London before your school trip?
loesungen: Had you visited London before your school trip?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Richtig: Had + Subjekt + 3. Form (visited).

aufgabe.anweisung: Markiere die 3. Formen in den verneinten Sätzen im past perfect.
aufgabe.satz: Leo didn't go to the party. He hadn't finished his project, and his mum wasn't happy about it. He hadn't even started it!
aufgabe.erklaerung: hadn't finished und hadn't started sind verneintes past perfect; didn't go ist simple past.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb verneint im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: Our team lost the match on Saturday because we ___ enough.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Verneinung im past perfect: hadn't / had not + 3. Form.

aufgabe.anweisung: Verneine den Satz.
aufgabe.satz: Before the trip, Sara had read about the British Empire.
loesungen: Before the trip, Sara hadn't read about the British Empire.
Before the trip, Sara had not read about the British Empire.
aufgabe.erklaerung: had read → hadn't / had not read.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde eine Frage aus den Teilen.
loesungen: Had you ever tried Indian food before?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Had + Subjekt + ever + 3. Form.

aufgabe.anweisung: Stelle die Frage zur Antwort. Benutze die Wörter in Klammern.
aufgabe.satz: No, she hadn't. It was her first time on a plane.
loesungen: Had your grandma ever flown before?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Antwort No, she hadn't → Frage mit Had + Subjekt + 3. Form (fly – flew – flown).

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze die Verben im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz:
A: Did you enjoy the school trip to London?
B: Yes! I ___ to London before.
A: ___ pictures of the Tower before the trip?
B: Yes, but I ___ it in real life. It was amazing.
A: And what about the food?
B: We went to an Indian restaurant. My friend Jake ___ chicken tikka masala before, but he loved it.
loesungen: had never been | Had you seen | hadn't seen | hadn't tried
aufgabe.erklaerung: Was vor dem Ausflug (nicht) passiert war: hadn't + 3. Form; Frage: Had you + 3. Form?

aufgabe.anweisung: Stelle die Frage zur Antwort. Benutze die Wörter in Klammern.
aufgabe.satz: Yes, he had. He had worked in a textile factory in his country.
aufgabe.vorgabe: (your grandfather / work / in a factory / before he came to Britain)
loesungen: Had your grandfather worked in a factory before he came to Britain?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Antwort Yes, he had → Frage mit Had + Subjekt + 3. Form.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb verneint im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: Five students ___ their tickets, so they couldn't go in.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Sie hatten die Tickets vorher nicht eingepackt → hadn't brought (bring – brought – brought).
aufgabe.kontext: Ms Hall's class went on a trip to a museum. At the door she was angry.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle das richtige Wort.
aufgabe.satz: ___ you finished your homework before the film started?
aufgabe.erklaerung: finished + before the film started (Vergangenheit) → Frage im past perfect: Had you finished …?

aufgabe.anweisung: Finde das falsche Wort und berichtige es.
aufgabe.satz: We hadn't went to the museum before.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Nach hadn't steht die 3. Form: hadn't gone (oder hadn't been).

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die richtige Form.
aufgabe.satz: Emma was a bit nervous because she ___ Indian food before.
aufgabe.erklaerung: never … before bis zu dem Abend (Vergangenheit) → had never eaten.
aufgabe.kontext: Emma's family went to an Indian restaurant for the first time.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ordne jeder Frage die passende Kurzantwort zu.
loesungen: Had your parents met before university? No, they hadn't. | Did your parents meet at university? Yes, they did. | Had the film started when you arrived? Yes, it had. | Was the film good? No, it wasn't.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Die Kurzantwort wiederholt das Hilfsverb der Frage: Had …? → had/hadn't, Did …? → did.

paare.links: Had your parents met before university?
Did your parents meet at university?
Had the film started when you arrived?
Was the film good?

aufgabe.anweisung: Markiere die 3. Formen, die zu einer Frage oder Verneinung im past perfect gehören.
aufgabe.satz: When Jamal's family arrived in Britain, nobody met them at the airport. 'Had Uncle Ravi forgotten about us?' his mum asked. Jamal's dad hadn't heard from Ravi for weeks.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Had … forgotten (Frage) und hadn't heard (Verneinung) sind past perfect; arrived, met und asked sind simple past.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch?
aufgabe.satz: Hadn't anyone told you about the school trip?
loesungen: Hadn't anyone told you about the school trip?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Richtig: verneinte Frage im past perfect – Hadn't + Subjekt + 3. Form (told).

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb verneint im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: He ___ there for fifty years, so everything looked different.
aufgabe.erklaerung: for fifty years bis zum Besuch (Vergangenheit) → hadn't been.
aufgabe.kontext: Last summer Grandpa visited the village where he grew up.

aufgabe.anweisung: Frage nach der Dauer. Beginne mit How long.
aufgabe.satz: The ship had been at sea for six weeks.
loesungen: How long had the ship been at sea?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Fragewort + had + Subjekt + 3. Form: How long had the ship been …?

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde eine Frage aus den Teilen.
loesungen: Why hadn't the men used the new machines?
Why hadn't the new men used the machines?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Fragewort + hadn't + Subjekt + 3. Form.

aufgabe.anweisung: Stelle die Frage zur Antwort. Benutze die Wörter in Klammern.
aufgabe.satz: Yes, I had. I had read about colonialism in a book.
aufgabe.vorgabe: (you / learn / about colonialism / before the lesson)
loesungen: Had you learnt about colonialism before the lesson?
Had you learned about colonialism before the lesson?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Antwort Yes, I had → Frage mit Had + Subjekt + 3. Form.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze die Verben im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz:
A: Why were you so late for school this morning?
B: I missed the bus. I ___ my mum when she called me.
A: Oh no! ___ your homework before you went to bed?
B: Yes, but when I got to school, I saw that I ___ my maths book.
A: What did Mr Fox say?
B: Nothing. He ___ about the homework himself!
loesungen: hadn't heard | Had you done | hadn't packed | had forgotten
aufgabe.erklaerung: Was vor dem Zuspätkommen (nicht) passiert war: hadn't + 3. Form; Frage: Had you + 3. Form?

aufgabe.anweisung: Stelle die Frage zur Antwort. Benutze die Wörter in Klammern.
aufgabe.satz: No, they hadn't. It was their first time in a big city.
aufgabe.vorgabe: (the children / ever / be / in a big city / before)
loesungen: Had the children ever been in a big city before?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Antwort No, they hadn't → Had + Subjekt + ever + 3. Form.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: He ___ a restaurant before, so the first year was extremely hard.
aufgabe.erklaerung: never … before bis 1975 → had never run (run – ran – run).
aufgabe.kontext: Mr Patel opened a restaurant in 1975.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle das richtige Wort.
aufgabe.satz: Grandma, ___ you ever visited Britain before you moved here?
aufgabe.erklaerung: visited (3. Form) + before you moved (Vergangenheit) → Frage im past perfect: had you visited.
aufgabe.kontext: Ben is talking to his grandma about her life.

aufgabe.anweisung: Finde das falsche Wort und berichtige es.
aufgabe.satz: Why hadn't you wrote to your grandmother?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Nach hadn't steht die 3. Form: write – wrote – written.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die richtige Form.
aufgabe.satz: When they arrived, their cousin ___ a flat for them yet, so they had to stay in a hotel.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Bis zur Ankunft (Vergangenheit) noch nicht → hadn't found … yet.
aufgabe.kontext: In 1971 Mr Singh's family left their home and moved to Britain.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch?
aufgabe.satz: Had the British ever asked the Indigenous people before they took their land?
loesungen: Had the British ever asked the Indigenous people before they took their land?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Richtig: Had + Subjekt + ever + 3. Form; nach before steht took im simple past.

aufgabe.anweisung: Markiere die 3. Formen, die zu einer Frage oder Verneinung im past perfect gehören.
aufgabe.satz: 'Hadn't the guide told you about the jewels?' Ms Green asked. Nobody answered. Most students hadn't listened, and two of them had even fallen asleep on the coach.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Hadn't … told (Frage) und hadn't listened (Verneinung); had fallen ist past perfect, aber weder Frage noch Verneinung.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ordne jeder Frage die passende Antwort zu.
loesungen: Where had you lived before you moved to Britain? In a small village in the mountains. | Where did you live after you moved to Britain? In a flat in East London. | Why hadn't you learnt English before? Because there wasn't a teacher in our village. | Why did you learn English so quickly? Because I had to speak it every day at work.
aufgabe.erklaerung: had + 3. Form fragt nach der Zeit davor, did nach der Zeit in Britain.

paare.rechts: Because I had to speak it every day at work.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb verneint im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: Lena had to stay at home on Saturday because she ___ her room all week.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Die ganze Woche vor Samstag → hadn't tidied (tidy → tidied).

aufgabe.anweisung: Frage nach dem Grund. Beginne mit Why.
aufgabe.satz: Tom hadn't packed his belongings.
loesungen: Why hadn't Tom packed his belongings?
Why had Tom not packed his belongings?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Why + hadn't + Subjekt + 3. Form.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde eine Frage aus den Teilen.
loesungen: How many colonies had Britain lost by 1960?
aufgabe.erklaerung: How many + Nomen + had + Subjekt + 3. Form.

aufgabe.anweisung: Stelle die Frage zur Antwort. Benutze die Wörter in Klammern.
aufgabe.satz: No, he hadn't. It was the first time that he had travelled so far from home.
aufgabe.vorgabe: (your grandfather / ever / travel / so far / before)
loesungen: Had your grandfather ever travelled so far before?
Had your grandfather ever traveled so far before?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Antwort No, he hadn't → Had + Subjekt + ever + 3. Form.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze die Verben im past perfect oder simple past ein.
aufgabe.satz:
A: Grandma, what was it like when you came to Britain in 1968?
B: It was hard. I ___ in a big city before.
A: ___ a flat for you?
B: No, they hadn't. So we stayed with friends for the first months, and at first I ___ people's accent at all.
A: When ___ Grandpa?
B: In 1970. By then I ___ much better English!
loesungen: had never lived | Had your parents already found | didn't understand | did you meet | had already learnt
aufgabe.erklaerung: never … before, already und by then → past perfect; was damals geschah (verstehen, kennenlernen) → simple past mit did.

aufgabe.anweisung: Stelle die Frage zur Antwort. Benutze die Wörter in Klammern.
aufgabe.satz: He had lived there for three years.
aufgabe.vorgabe: (How long / his brother / live / in London / by then)
loesungen: How long had his brother lived in London by then?
aufgabe.erklaerung: by then = bis zu diesem Zeitpunkt in der Vergangenheit → How long had … lived?
aufgabe.kontext: Grandpa arrived in London in 1962. His brother met him at the station.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: She felt nervous because she ___ in a class with thirty children before.
aufgabe.erklaerung: never … before bis zum ersten Schultag → had never sat (sit – sat – sat).
aufgabe.kontext: Mila's first day at her new school in Britain was in September.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle das richtige Wort.
aufgabe.satz: What ___ you expected before you arrived, Grandma?
aufgabe.erklaerung: expected (3. Form) + before you arrived (Vergangenheit) → What had you expected?
aufgabe.kontext: Ella's grandmother was telling her about her first day in Britain.

aufgabe.anweisung: Finde das falsche Wort und berichtige es.
aufgabe.satz: Hadn't the factory owners knew that the machines were dangerous?
aufgabe.erklaerung: know – knew – known: Hadn't the owners known …?

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die richtige Form.
aufgabe.satz: When he got to the shop, he realised that he ___ his money at home.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Rückblende: Das Liegenlassen war vor dem Merken → had left.
aufgabe.kontext: Last Sunday Leo wanted to buy some chicken for dinner.

aufgabe.anweisung: Markiere in der Geschichte die 3. Formen der Verben im past perfect.
aufgabe.satz: Mia came home late. The house was quiet. Her parents had gone to bed, and somebody had switched off the lights. Mia smiled. Her mum had left a piece of cake for her on the table.
aufgabe.erklaerung: had gone, had switched und had left blicken zurück; came und smiled erzählen die Handlung (simple past).

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch?
aufgabe.satz: When Sam got to the station, he found out that his train had already left.
loesungen: When Sam got to the station, he found out that his train had already left.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Richtig: Der Zug war vor Sams Ankunft abgefahren → had already left.

aufgabe.anweisung: Was war vorher passiert? Ordne die passende Rückblende zu.
loesungen: Tom was very tired at school. He had watched films until two in the morning. | Lisa couldn't get into her flat. She had lost her key on the way home. | The kitchen was a mess. The children had made a big cake. | Grandpa smiled at the old photo. He had taken it on his wedding day.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Die Rückblende im past perfect erklärt, warum die Lage in der Geschichte so war.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: When Emma got to the cinema, she realised that she ___ the tickets.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Rückblende nach realised: had forgotten (forget – forgot – forgotten).

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: The streets were wet. It ___ all night.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Der Regen war vor dem Morgen → had rained.
aufgabe.kontext: Tim looked out of the window in the morning.

aufgabe.anweisung: Erzähle in der Vergangenheit. Ändere beide Sätze.
aufgabe.satz: Jenny is happy. She has found her dog.
loesungen: Jenny was happy. She had found her dog.
Jenny was happy. She'd found her dog.
aufgabe.erklaerung: is → was; has found wird beim Erzählen zu had found.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde einen Satz aus den Teilen.
loesungen: Somebody had taken my bike from the garden.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Subjekt + had + 3. Form + Objekt + Ortsangabe.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze die Verben im past perfect oder simple past ein.
aufgabe.satz: Last Saturday Ben went to the market with his grandfather. When they got to the fruit stall, Grandpa looked in his pocket and noticed that he ___ his money. So they ___ home again. At home, Ben's grandma laughed. She ___ the money on the kitchen table an hour before. 'Next time I'll check my pockets,' Grandpa ___.
loesungen: had lost | walked | had found | said
aufgabe.erklaerung: Rückblenden (had lost, had found … before) im past perfect; die Handlung der Geschichte (walked, said) im simple past.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: The house was very clean. Her dad ___ all the rooms.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Das Aufräumen war vor Amys Heimkehr → had tidied.
aufgabe.kontext: Yesterday Amy came home from school at four.

aufgabe.anweisung: Verbinde die beiden Sätze mit because. Benutze das past perfect.
aufgabe.satz: Grandpa was tired. He worked in the factory all day.
loesungen: Grandpa was tired because he had worked in the factory all day.
Grandpa was tired because he'd worked in the factory all day.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Der Grund liegt vor dem Müdesein → Rückblende: he had worked.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die richtige Form.
aufgabe.satz: He looked everywhere, and then he remembered that he ___ it at Jack's house.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Rückblick auf etwas Früheres in der Geschichte → had left.
aufgabe.kontext: Tom's phone wasn't in his bag.

aufgabe.anweisung: Finde das falsche Wort und berichtige es.
aufgabe.satz: When I got home, I saw that someone had took my football.
aufgabe.erklaerung: take – took – taken: had taken.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die richtige Form.
aufgabe.satz: On his first day at school, he was nervous because he ___ English with other children before.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Rückblick vor den ersten Schultag: had never spoken (speak – spoke – spoken).
aufgabe.kontext: Ravi's family moved to Britain when he was ten.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch? Wenn er falsch ist, berichtige das falsche Wort.
aufgabe.satz: When the servants came into the room, they saw that somebody had stole the jewels.
aufgabe.erklaerung: steal – stole – stolen: had stolen.

aufgabe.anweisung: Markiere die 3. Formen der Verben im past perfect.
aufgabe.satz: Ella found an old box in the attic. Inside there were letters that her grandfather had written in 1960. He had just arrived in Britain, and he had sent them to his mother. Ella read them all.
aufgabe.erklaerung: had written, had arrived und had sent blicken zurück; found und read erzählen die Handlung.

aufgabe.anweisung: Handlung der Geschichte oder Rückblende? Ordne zu.
loesungen: Handlung (simple past): Jess had a cup of tea., She looked out of the window., Jess had a long talk with her mum. | Rückblende (past perfect): She'd forgotten her keys., Her friend had already gone out., It had rained all morning., The bus had left.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Rückblende = had + 3. Form. „had a cup of tea“ ist simple past von have (Vollverb).

elemente.text: Jess had a cup of tea.
She looked out of the window.
Jess had a long talk with her mum.
She'd forgotten her keys.
Her friend had already gone out.
It had rained all morning.
The bus had left.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: They ___ at sea for five weeks.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Die fünf Wochen lagen vor der Ankunft → had been.
aufgabe.kontext: When the ship reached Britain, the passengers were extremely tired.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: When Kim opened the letter, she found out that she ___ the competition.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Gewonnen hatte sie schon vor dem Öffnen des Briefs → had won (win – won – won).

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde einen Satz aus den Teilen.
loesungen: Josh noticed that he had forgotten his key.
aufgabe.erklaerung: noticed (Handlung) + that + Rückblende im past perfect.

aufgabe.anweisung: Stelle die Frage zur Antwort. Benutze die Wörter in Klammern.
aufgabe.satz: Yes, she had. She had worked as a nurse back home.
aufgabe.vorgabe: (your grandmother / work / as a nurse / before)
loesungen: Had your grandmother worked as a nurse before?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Antwort Yes, she had → Had + Subjekt + 3. Form.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze die Verben im past perfect oder simple past ein.
aufgabe.satz: In 1958 Sanjay's grandfather arrived in London with only one small bag of belongings. He was cold and hungry because he ___ anything since the day before. He ___ a cheap room near the station and went to bed early. The next morning he looked out of the window and couldn't believe his eyes: it ___ in the night! He ___ snow before. Later that day he ___ his first job in a textile factory.
loesungen: hadn't eaten | found | had snowed | had never seen | started
aufgabe.erklaerung: Rückblenden (since the day before, in the night, never … before) → past perfect; die Handlung (found, started) → simple past.

aufgabe.anweisung: Verbinde die beiden Sätze mit because. Benutze das past perfect.
aufgabe.satz: The servants were tired. They cleaned the whole house for the party.
loesungen: The servants were tired because they had cleaned the whole house for the party.
The servants were tired because they'd cleaned the whole house for the party.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Der Grund liegt vor dem Müdesein → they had cleaned.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: Grandma was very happy to see her because nobody ___ her for weeks.
aufgabe.erklaerung: for weeks bis zu Hollys Besuch → had visited (nobody ist schon die Verneinung).
aufgabe.kontext: Last week Holly visited her grandmother in hospital.

aufgabe.anweisung: Welcher Satz bedeutet: Die Katze hatte die Milch schon ausgetrunken, als Ann in die Küche kam? Wähle.
loesungen: When Ann came into the kitchen, the cat had drunk the milk.
optionen: When Ann came into the kitchen, the cat had drunk the milk.
When Ann came into the kitchen, the cat drank the milk.
When Ann came into the kitchen, the cat was drinking the milk.
aufgabe.erklaerung: had drunk = schon vorher passiert; drank = danach; was drinking = gerade dabei.

aufgabe.anweisung: Finde das falsche Wort und berichtige es.
aufgabe.satz: Amy was embarrassed because she had wore the wrong uniform to school.
aufgabe.erklaerung: wear – wore – worn: had worn.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die richtige Form.
aufgabe.satz: She found the work easy because she ___ in a hospital back home for several years.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Rückblick auf die Jahre vor 1965 → had worked.
aufgabe.kontext: In 1965 Asha's grandmother started work as a nurse in a London hospital.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch?
aufgabe.satz: When the banker came home, he found out that one of his servants had sold his carriage and run away.
loesungen: When the banker came home, he found out that one of his servants had sold his carriage and run away.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Richtig: had sold and (had) run away – das zweite had kann wegfallen; run ist die 3. Form.

aufgabe.anweisung: Markiere die 3. Formen der Verben, die im past perfect stehen.
aufgabe.satz: It was raining when Nadia's family landed in London in 1974. They had sold almost everything back home, and they had very little money. Nadia's father had found a job in a factory before they left, so they knew that they had somewhere to go.
aufgabe.erklaerung: had sold und had found sind Rückblenden; in „had very little money“ und „had somewhere to go“ ist had ein Vollverb.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ordne jedem Satzanfang das passende Ende zu.
loesungen: When Ella opened her school bag, she realised that she had left her maths book at home. | When the servants came into the dining room, they saw that the guests had already finished their dinner. | When the ship finally reached the coast, the passengers had been at sea for six weeks. | When the factory got electricity, the owner had already ordered new machines.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Der Hauptsatz blickt mit had + 3. Form auf etwas zurück, das vor dem when-Satz geschehen war.

paare.links: When Ella opened her school bag,
paare.rechts: she realised that she had left her maths book at home.

paare.links: When the servants came into the dining room,
paare.rechts: they saw that the guests had already finished their dinner.

paare.links: When the ship finally reached the coast,
paare.rechts: the passengers had been at sea for six weeks.

paare.links: When the factory got electricity,
paare.rechts: the owner had already ordered new machines.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: He hardly recognised it: most of the old textile factories ___.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Das Verschwinden lag vor dem Besuch → had disappeared.
aufgabe.kontext: Last week Mr Hill visited the town where he grew up.

aufgabe.anweisung: Erzähle den Satz in der Vergangenheit.
aufgabe.satz: When Mia gets home, she realises that someone has broken into the house and has taken her laptop.
loesungen: When Mia got home, she realised that someone had broken into the house and had taken her laptop.
When Mia got home, she realised that someone had broken into the house and taken her laptop.
When Mia got home, she realized that someone had broken into the house and had taken her laptop.
When Mia got home, she realized that someone had broken into the house and taken her laptop.
aufgabe.erklaerung: realises → realised (Handlung); has broken / has taken → had broken / had taken (Rückblende).

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde einen Satz aus den Teilen.
loesungen: The men had never seen such a big machine before that day.
aufgabe.erklaerung: had + never + 3. Form; before that day nennt den Bezugspunkt.

aufgabe.anweisung: Stelle die Frage zur Antwort. Benutze die Wörter in Klammern.
aufgabe.satz: No, they hadn't. It was a big surprise for them.
aufgabe.vorgabe: (the immigrants / know / about the new law / before they arrived)
loesungen: Had the immigrants known about the new law before they arrived?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Antwort No, they hadn't → Had + Subjekt + 3. Form (know – knew – known).

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze die Verben im past perfect oder simple past ein.
aufgabe.satz: Last summer Priya ___ a box of old letters in her grandmother's attic. They were from her great-grandfather, who came to Britain in 1956. By the time he wrote the first letter, he ___ in London for three months. He ___ such a big city before, and everything was new to him. When Priya ___ the letters to her grandmother, the old lady started to cry. She ___ them for more than forty years.
loesungen: found | had already lived | had never seen | showed | hadn't read
aufgabe.erklaerung: by the time/already, never … before und for forty years → Rückblende im past perfect; die Handlung (found, showed) im simple past.

aufgabe.anweisung: Verbinde die beiden Sätze mit after. Benutze das past perfect.
aufgabe.satz: Grandpa lost his job in the factory. So he decided to open a small shop.
loesungen: After Grandpa had lost his job in the factory, he decided to open a small shop.
After Grandpa had lost his job in the factory he decided to open a small shop.
Grandpa decided to open a small shop after he had lost his job in the factory.
Grandpa decided to open a small shop after he'd lost his job in the factory.
After he had lost his job in the factory, Grandpa decided to open a small shop.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Die frühere Handlung steht nach after im past perfect: had lost.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: His little brother ___ them by mistake.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Die Rückblende erklärt, warum die Fotos fehlten → had deleted.
aufgabe.kontext: Jack wanted to show his friends the photos from his trip to London. But when he turned on his computer, the photos weren't there.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die richtige Form.
aufgabe.satz: When I got off the ship, I found out that somebody ___ my bag.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Rückblende in einer Geschichte: had + 3. Form (steal – stole – stolen), nicht has.
aufgabe.kontext: Ben's grandpa was telling a story about his first day in Britain.

aufgabe.anweisung: Finde das falsche Wort und berichtige es.
aufgabe.satz: When the banker opened the safe, he saw that his servant had took all the jewels.
aufgabe.erklaerung: take – took – taken: had taken.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die richtige Form.
aufgabe.satz: When Grandpa got to the station, the train ___ already left.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Der Zug fuhr vor Grandpas Ankunft ab → had + 3. Form (had left).
aufgabe.kontext: The train left at 9 o'clock. Grandpa got to the station at 9:10.

aufgabe.anweisung: Welche Verbform passt nach „had“? Sortiere die Wörter.
loesungen: passt nach had (3. Form): gone, seen, written, taken | passt nicht nach had (simple past): went, saw, wrote, took
aufgabe.erklaerung: Das past perfect bildest du mit had + 3. Form: had gone, had seen, had written, had taken.

elemente.text: gone
went
seen
saw
written
wrote
taken
took

aufgabe.anweisung: Markiere die 3. Formen, die mit „had“ ein past perfect bilden.
aufgabe.satz: In 1972 Amir's grandfather came to London. He had worked in a textile factory before. He had saved money for the journey, and he had a small bag with all his belongings.
aufgabe.erklaerung: had worked und had saved sind past perfect; in „he had a small bag“ ist had ein Vollverb (= hatte).

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch?
aufgabe.satz: Before she moved to Britain, my grandmother had never seen snow.
loesungen: Before she moved to Britain, my grandmother had never seen snow.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Richtig: had never seen (had + 3. Form) – das war vor dem Umzug.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: By the time the ship arrived in England, the passengers ___ for three weeks.
aufgabe.erklaerung: by the time + simple past, die Zeit davor im past perfect: had travelled.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: When Grandpa opened the letter, he read that his brother ___ a job in London.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Der Bruder fand die Arbeit vor dem Brief → had + 3. Form: had found.

aufgabe.anweisung: Mache aus dem Aussagesatz eine Frage im past perfect.
aufgabe.satz: Mr Khan had worked in a textile factory.
loesungen: Had Mr Khan worked in a textile factory?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Frage im past perfect: Had + Subjekt + 3. Form.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde einen Satz im past perfect.
loesungen: My grandfather had never seen snow before 1965.
aufgabe.erklaerung: never steht zwischen had und der 3. Form: had never seen.

aufgabe.anweisung: Lies die Situation und setze das Verb mit dem Signalwort im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz: When Jack walked into the classroom, the lesson ___.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Die Stunde begann vor Jacks Ankunft → had already started (already zwischen had und 3. Form).
aufgabe.kontext: Jack got up late this morning. The lesson started at 8 o'clock, and Jack got to school at 8:20.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ergänze den Dialog. Setze die Verben im past perfect ein.
aufgabe.satz:
A: Why did your grandfather come to Britain in 1960?
B: His brother ___ to London, and he wanted to be near him.
A: Was it easy for him?
B: No. He ___ to a big city before, so everything was new.
A: Did he speak English?
B: A little. But when he found his first job, he ___ a lot more.
A: And when did he open his shop?
B: In 1975. By the time my dad was born, Grandpa ___ a small shop in the middle of town.
loesungen: had already moved | hadn't been | had already learnt | had bought
aufgabe.erklaerung: Alles, was vor dem Zeitpunkt in der Vergangenheit passiert war, steht im past perfect: had moved, hadn't been, had learnt, had bought.

aufgabe.anweisung: Verbinde die Sätze mit „when“ und „already“. Nimm das past perfect.
aufgabe.satz: The last train left at 11 o'clock. Ravi got to the station at 11:20.
loesungen: When Ravi got to the station, the last train had already left.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Der Zug fuhr zuerst ab → the last train had already left.
aufgabe.anfang: When Ravi got to the station,

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die richtige Form.
aufgabe.satz: Before that, they ___ in Pakistan for many years.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Die Zeit in Pakistan lag vor 2010 (Vergangenheit) → had lived, nicht present perfect.
aufgabe.kontext: Lisa's family came to Britain in 2010.

aufgabe.anweisung: Finde den Fehler und berichtige ihn mit einem Wort.
aufgabe.satz: When Grandpa arrived in Britain, he had never saw snow.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Nach had kommt die 3. Form: had never seen.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die richtige Form.
aufgabe.satz: But when she got to school, she saw that she ___ it at home.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Die Jacke blieb schon vorher zu Hause liegen → had left.
aufgabe.kontext: Kate wanted to show her new jacket to her friends.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle alle Sätze, in denen das past perfect richtig gebildet ist.
loesungen: The goods had arrived before the shop opened.
Had the servants cleaned the carriage?
By the time we came, they'd sold all the tea.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Past perfect = had/’d + 3. Form: had arrived, had cleaned, ’d sold – nicht had build oder hadn't went.
optionen: The goods had arrived before the shop opened.
The men had build a new machine.
Had the servants cleaned the carriage?
She hadn't went to the market.
By the time we came, they'd sold all the tea.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ist der Satz richtig oder falsch?
aufgabe.satz: After the factory had closed, many people in the town lost their jobs.
loesungen: After the factory had closed, many people in the town lost their jobs.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Richtig: Zuerst schloss die Fabrik (had closed), danach verloren die Leute ihre Arbeit (lost).

aufgabe.anweisung: Ordne die passenden Satzhälften zu.
loesungen: By the time the police came, the man had run away. | Emma didn't want any cake because she had already eaten a lot. | The pupils were embarrassed because they hadn't done their homework. | Had you ever seen the sea before you moved to Britain?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Was vor dem anderen Ereignis passiert war, steht im past perfect; die Frage beginnt mit Had.

aufgabe.anweisung: Setze das Verb in der richtigen Form ein.
aufgabe.satz: By the time we got to the beach, the rain ___.
aufgabe.erklaerung: by the time + simple past: Was bis dahin schon passiert war, steht im past perfect → had stopped.

aufgabe.anweisung: Frage nach der Zeitdauer. Bilde eine Frage im past perfect.
aufgabe.satz: Grandpa's family had lived in the colony for a long time.
loesungen: How long had Grandpa's family lived in the colony?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Fragewort + had + Subjekt + 3. Form: How long had … lived …?

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde eine Frage im past perfect.
loesungen: Had the farmers ever seen such a machine before?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Frage im past perfect: Had + Subjekt + ever + 3. Form.

aufgabe.anweisung: Bilde die passende Frage im past perfect. Nutze die Wörter in Klammern.
aufgabe.satz: They had worked in a textile factory.
aufgabe.vorgabe: (Where / Tom's grandparents / work / before they came to Britain)
loesungen: Where had Tom's grandparents worked before they came to Britain?
aufgabe.erklaerung: Where + had + Subjekt + 3. Form; der Nebensatz mit before bleibt im simple past.

aufgabe.anweisung: Ergänze die Geschichte. Entscheide: simple past oder past perfect?
aufgabe.satz: When Grandpa Ali ___ in Bradford in 1961, it was a cold, grey day. He ___ such a grey sky before. Luckily, a friend from his village ___ a room for him, so he had a place to sleep on the first night. The next morning he ___ work in a textile factory.
loesungen: arrived | had never seen | had already found | started
aufgabe.erklaerung: Die Handlung der Geschichte steht im simple past (arrived, started); was davor war, im past perfect (had never seen, had already found).

aufgabe.anweisung: Verbinde die Sätze mit „by the time“.
aufgabe.satz: Most of the guests left the party at ten. Leo arrived at half past ten.
loesungen: By the time Leo arrived, most of the guests had left the party.
By the time Leo arrived, most of the guests had already left the party.
By the time Leo arrived, most of the guests had left.
By the time Leo arrived, most of the guests had already left.
aufgabe.erklaerung: by the time + simple past; das frühere Ereignis im past perfect: had left.

aufgabe.anweisung: Lies die Situation und setze das Verb in der richtigen Form ein.
aufgabe.satz: By 1947 Britain ___ India for almost 200 years.
aufgabe.erklaerung: by 1947 = bis zu einem Zeitpunkt in der Vergangenheit → past perfect: had ruled.
aufgabe.kontext: India became independent in 1947.

aufgabe.anweisung: Wähle die richtige Form.
aufgabe.satz: Ben ___ there before, so he showed his friends the best rooms.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Ben war schon vor dem Besuch letzte Woche dort gewesen → had been.
aufgabe.kontext: Last week Ben and his class visited the museum.

aufgabe.anweisung: Finde den Fehler und berichtige ihn mit einem Wort.
aufgabe.satz: Last night, by the time Dad came home, we have already eaten.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Last night, Dad came home → Vergangenheit; das Essen war schon vorher → had already eaten.

aufgabe.anweisung: Lies den Satz im Kontext. Welche Aussagen stimmen? Wähle alle richtigen.
loesungen: Ella didn't see Max at the party.
aufgabe.erklaerung: had left = Max war schon gegangen, als Ella kam – sie haben sich nicht gesehen.
aufgabe.kontext: When Ella arrived at the party, Max had left.
optionen: Ella and Max were at the party together.
Ella didn't see Max at the party.

aufgabe.anweisung: Simple past oder past perfect? Ordne jedem Satz die passende Bedeutung zu.
loesungen: When the guests arrived, Grandma made tea. The guests came first, and then she started. | When the guests arrived, Grandma had made tea. The tea was ready before the guests came. | When the bell rang, the pupils left the room. The pupils waited for the bell. | When the bell rang, the pupils had left the room. Nobody was in the room at that moment.
aufgabe.erklaerung: Simple past: das eine nach dem anderen. Past perfect: Es war schon vorher passiert.

paare.rechts: The pupils waited for the bell.
